title: Stop using app_localizations_coverage_test.dart's 1482 zero-assertion lines to pad the CI coverage floor over generated l10n code
rule: TQ-8 / Rule 0 (coverage floor's stated generated-file exclusion is unenforced)

evidence.quote: return paths. No assertion is made on the text — the goal is line coverage of the generated translation strings.

why: grep -c 'expect(' on the file returns 0 — in 1482 lines, nothing can ever fail except a compile error (e.g. a renamed getter), which would abort the whole file rather than flag the specific key. The file's own docstring admits its purpose is purely to drive line-execution through lib/l10n/app_localizations_en.dart and _he.dart (5100+ generated lines each) for the CI-enforced coverage floor. docs/coding-standards.md states the 60% line-coverage floor is measured with 'generated files excluded', but .github/workflows/ci.yml's coverage-floor step runs `lcov --summary` directly on the raw lcov.info with no `lcov --remove` step anywhere in the repo (verified: no lcov --remove/genhtml exclude pattern exists in Makefile or ci.yml) — so generated files are NOT excluded in practice, and this file's 725-getter roll call launders thousands of auto-generated, logic-free lines into the numerator that the doc claims shouldn't count. Concrete cost: every new l10n key needs a manual line added here (already 725, and easy to forget silently since forgetting produces no failure), for a test that cannot catch a wrong translation, a missing plural case, or the exact ARB duplicate-key bug found elsewhere in this batch.
recommendation: Either (a) wire the promised exclusion into the CI coverage step (lcov --remove coverage/lcov.info 'lib/l10n/app_localizations_*.dart' '*.g.dart' ... before lcov --summary) and delete this file, or (b) if kept for its doc-verification role, replace the per-getter roll call with a real check (e.g. that every ARB key has a corresponding generated getter) instead of 1482 lines that assert nothing.
acceptance_criteria: CI's coverage-floor step excludes generated files from the denominator (matching the doc's claim) OR this file is deleted/replaced with an assertive test.
docs/coding-standards.md's 'generated files excluded' claim matches what .github/workflows/ci.yml actually does.

corrections: Second evidence entry's file path 'learning_tracker/.github/workflows/ci.yml' is wrong — the file is at repo-root '.github/workflows/ci.yml' (no learning_tracker/ prefix). Content and line 256 quote are otherwise verified correct at that path.
